simple.meaning: מַצֵּבָה (matstsêbâh) is a Hebrew object word meaning “something stationed , i.e. a column or (memorial stone); by analogy, an idol.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Genesis 28:18. The surrounding context includes land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מַצֵּבָה (H4676) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
